import numpy as np
import mujoco
from scipy.linalg import solve

class Control:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s; self.m=s.model; self.d=s.data; self.tmp=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
  self.n=25; self.nx=37
  self.qhome=self.d.qpos[7:26].copy(); self.qhome[0:11]=[0,0,-.4,.8,-.4,0,0,-.4,.8,-.4,0]
  self.feet=[self.d.site_xpos[i].copy() for i in [1,2]]
  for p in self.feet:p[2]=0.005
  self.com=self.d.subtree_com[1].copy();self.com[2]=.94
  self.rot=np.eye(3);self.hands=[None,None]
  self.gain=self.m.actuator_gainprm[:,0];self.damp=-self.m.actuator_biasprm[:,2]
  self.mass=np.zeros((self.m.nv,self.m.nv))
 def jac(self,d,typ,id):
  p=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));r=p.copy()
  if typ=='site':mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.m,d,p,r,id)
  elif typ=='body':mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,d,p,r,id)
  else:mujoco.mj_jacSubtreeCom(self.m,d,p,id)
  return p[:,:25],r[:,:25]
 def action(self,com=None,feet=None,hands=None,support=(1,1)):
  m,d=self.m,self.d;n=25;nx=37
  if com is None:com=self.com
  if feet is None:feet=self.feet
  if hands is None:hands=self.hands
  v=d.qvel[:25]
  self.tmp.qpos[:]=d.qpos;self.tmp.qvel[:]=d.qvel
  eps=1e-5;mujoco.mj_integratePos(m,self.tmp.qpos,d.qvel,eps);mujoco.mj_forward(m,self.tmp)
  H=np.eye(nx)*1e-7;g=np.zeros(nx)
  def task(J,b,w):
   nonlocal H,g
   A=np.zeros((len(b),nx));A[:,:n]=J
   H+=w*A.T@A;g-=w*A.T@b
  def track(typ,id,target,kp,w,rot=None):
   J,R=self.jac(d,typ,id);J1,R1=self.jac(self.tmp,typ,id)
   pos=d.site_xpos[id] if typ=='site' else d.xpos[id] if typ=='body' else d.subtree_com[id]
   task(J,kp*(target-pos)-2*np.sqrt(kp)*(J@v)-(J1-J)@v/eps,w)
   if rot is not None:
    mat=(d.site_xmat[id] if typ=='site' else d.xmat[id]).reshape(3,3)
    err=sum(np.cross(mat[:,i],rot[:,i]) for i in range(3))*.5
    task(R,kp*err-2*np.sqrt(kp)*(R@v)-(R1-R)@v/eps,w)
   return np.vstack([J,R])
  Jcs=[]
  for i in range(2):
   Jc=track('site',i+1,feet[i],250,80 if support[i] else 10,np.eye(3))
   Jcs.append(Jc)
  track('com',1,com,80,15)
  J,R=self.jac(d,'body',1);J1,R1=self.jac(self.tmp,'body',1)
  mat=d.xmat[1].reshape(3,3);err=sum(np.cross(mat[:,i],self.rot[:,i]) for i in range(3))*.5
  task(R,100*err-20*(R@v)-(R1-R)@v/eps,12)
  task(np.eye(n)[6:],40*(self.qhome-d.qpos[7:26])-10*v[6:],.15)
  for i in range(2):
   if hands[i] is not None:track('site',7+i,np.array(hands[i]),100,15)
  mujoco.mj_fullM(m,self.mass,d.qM)
  M=self.mass[:25,:25];bias=(d.qfrc_bias-d.qfrc_passive)[:25]
  B=np.concatenate(Jcs).T
  E=np.zeros((6,nx));E[:,:n]=M[:6];E[:,n:]=-B[:6]
  e=-bias[:6]
  # penalise force, and impossible swing forces strongly
  for i in range(2):
   H[25+6*i:31+6*i,25+6*i:31+6*i]+=np.diag([.0001,.0001,.00001,.0005,.0005,.001])*(1 if support[i] else 1e8)
  K=np.block([[H,E.T],[E,np.zeros((6,6))]])
  x=solve(K,np.r_[-g,e],assume_a='sym')[:nx]
  tau=M[6:]@x[:n]+bias[6:]-B[6:]@x[n:]
  target=d.qpos[7:26]+(tau+self.damp*v[6:])/self.gain
  a=2*(target-m.actuator_ctrlrange[:,0])/np.diff(m.actuator_ctrlrange,axis=1)[:,0]-1
  self.last=(x,tau)
  return np.clip(a,-1,1)
